entities.summary: Tyler Graovac is a Canadian professional ice hockey player. He is currently playing for HC Lada Togliatti of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Graovac was selected by the Minnesota Wild in the 7th round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft.
